targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, concat(strategy, ' ', metric_name) AS series, metric_value FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric_name IN ('hit_rate@1', 'hit_rate@3', 'hit_rate@5', 'hit_rate@10') ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time AS time, concat(strategy, ' ', metric_name) AS series, metric_value FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric_name IN ('mrr@10', 'ndcg@10', 'map@10') ORDER BY time

panels.title: CI Width: Smaller Means More Stable

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, concat(strategy, ' ', metric_name) AS series, metric_value FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric_name IN ('hit_rate@1_ci95_width', 'hit_rate@3_ci95_width', 'hit_rate@5_ci95_width', 'mrr@10_ci95_width', 'ndcg@10_ci95_width') ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time AS time, concat(strategy, ' ', metric_name) AS series, metric_value FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND metric_name IN ('duration_ms', 'search_duration_ms_mean', 'search_duration_ms_p95') ORDER BY time

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT strategy, metric_name, metric_value FROM code_diver.rag_eval_metrics WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name IN ('hit_rate@1','hit_rate@1_ci95_low','hit_rate@1_ci95_high','hit_rate@3','hit_rate@3_ci95_low','hit_rate@3_ci95_high','hit_rate@5','hit_rate@5_ci95_low','hit_rate@5_ci95_high','mrr@10','mrr@10_ci95_low','mrr@10_ci95_high','ndcg@10','ndcg@10_ci95_low','ndcg@10_ci95_high') ORDER BY strategy, metric_name

WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM code_diver.rag_eval_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT strategy, count() AS cases, avg(hit) AS hit_rate, stddevSamp(hit) AS hit_stddev, avg(reciprocal_rank) AS mrr, stddevSamp(reciprocal_rank) AS mrr_stddev, quantile(0.5)(reciprocal_rank) AS rr_p50, quantile(0.9)(reciprocal_rank) AS rr_p90, avg(recall) AS recall, stddevSamp(recall) AS recall_stddev FROM code_diver.rag_eval_cases WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM latest) GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY hit_rate DESC, mrr DESC

SELECT event_time, run_id, suite, strategy, case_id, hit, reciprocal_rank, precision, recall FROM code_diver.rag_eval_cases WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC, strategy, case_id LIMIT 500
